verdict.rationale: Linear docs are explicitly supported: teams can create docs from the team home page, attach existing documents to projects/issues, and organize them into sections (linear-docs-22), with mobile creation/editing (linear-docs-71) and Loops/Agent keeping docs updated (linear-docs-12, linear-docs-34). Product marketing also ties docs to PRDs and roadmaps alongside project work (linear-docs-63, linear-docs-76). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically about the docs feature and detail on doc-specific search/versioning.
